plotEn:
In 1986 Madras, Baththavachalam "Baththa" is a ruthless and dreaded local gangster. He commands total authority on the streets by instilling deep fear in everyone around him. Sabari is a young boy in the same neighbourhood. He witnesses Baththa brutally assaulting an enemy Jyoti and is terrified of him. Baththa is affectionate towards his tween daughter Themozhi "Thenu", but frequently mistreats his wife Kannima.
Sabari's toy is confiscated by his teacher right before the start of summer vacation. He overhears that the school security guard had been hospitalised and breaks into the school after the holidays start, at dawn to secretly retrieve the toy. After using the toilet, he promptly locks the bathroom and is terrified when someone knocks from the inside. He freezes with fear when the locked person identifies himself as Baththa, and threatens to kill whoever locked him up. Sabari runs away in fear, while Baththa contemplates which one of his enemies would have locked him up.
Sabari returns to the bathroom with some rusks, crushes and feed them through the door creek. For several days, Baththa only threatens him with violence, thinking he is being held by one of his opponents. A few days later, Baththa relents and begs to be set free, promising he will not cause any harm. Sabari, still being shaken by fear, only feeds him rusks, without speaking a word.
